title: DESCRIPTION
source:
*EXAMINATION WORKS:*

* Distributed the answer-copy bundles for the Post Mid-Term Exam.
* Printed & stapled the NUR-HINDI, K1-HINDI, K2-LITERACY & K2-LITERACY question paper for the POST-MID-TERM Exams.
* Stapled the G1-ELA, G2-EVS, G3-MATHS, G4-HINDI & G8-ELA question paper for the POST-MID-TERM Exams.
* Prepared and updated the Google sheet to reflect the submission status of the Post Mid term Bundle.
* Collected & Distributed the answer-copy bundles from the teachers.
* Given the Grade X Marksheet certificate to the student. (ID-1717)
* Bundling the Grade 1 to 4 for POST Mid-Term Exam Q&A (DAY-07 Exams).
* Formatted the ELA & MATHS question paper for grade X for the Pre-Board Exams.
* Printed the Pre-Board all questions paper for Grade-X for the HODs proofing.


*OTHER WORK:*

* Dispersal Duty.
* Bus Scanning (R-82)
* Prepared the Biometric attendance record of Teaching, Non-Teaching, Admin, Transport, Guard and 4th grade employee given by Principal Sir.
